note: Hand-written development questions over the 2026-10-29 acquired corpus. Gold locators were chosen by reading the acquired text, not by looking at retriever output. Small N: results are a smoke test and a regression baseline, not a retrieval-quality claim. A hit means the retrieved provision equals a gold locator, sits beneath it, or lies in the named section/document; it never means the rule applies to any bank.
